subject: SellWith Accelerator integrator pilot — Orchid Analytics + Redwood
content:
From: Sam Patel <sam@orchid-analytics.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: Sara Lopez <sara@brightlayer.consulting>
Date: Fri, 07 Jun 2029 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: 8-week SellWith Accelerator pilot (Orchid + Redwood)

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the intro last week. Orchid Analytics builds an RAG-enabled insights product for retail ops; we’ve been field-testing a Redwood-powered inference path for the last month and want to propose a formal 8-week pilot that bundles:

- an integrator engagement (BrightLayer) to wire up SSO + data connectors
- a sandbox private-offer listing on AWS (SellWith path) for co-sell discovery
- joint GTM assets + a webinar at pilot close

High-level asks on our side: a POC tenant with dedicated capacity (small pool), proof-of-concept credits, guidance on marketplace metering and SKU mapping, and (ideally) a short co-sell commitment window if metrics look good. I’ve attached a one-page pilot-outline with target metrics.

Can we line up a short cross-functional kickoff next week? Sara (cc’d) will be our BrightLayer lead and can share scope.

Attachments: orchid-pilot-outline.pdf (one-pager)

Best,
Sam Patel
Head of Partnerships, Orchid Analytics
sam@orchid-analytics.com | +1 415-555-0132

---

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
To: Sam Patel <sam@orchid-analytics.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 07 Jun 2029 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: 8-week SellWith Accelerator pilot (Orchid + Redwood)

Sam — really exciting fit, thank you. Looping in Ben (Partnerships), Vivek (GTM/marketplace), and Connor (technical lead) so we can cover approvals and execution. Quick responses to the asks below and proposed next steps: 

- POC tenant / reserved capacity: doable — dev will provision a dedicated small pool for an 8-week window. Connor, can you confirm ETA?
- Credits: we can put together a pilot credit package; Ben will scope based on expected token consumption.
- Marketplace metering / SKU mapping: Vivek, we’ll need the standard SellWith intake (evidence + SKU mapping). Sam, please share expected daily QPS and a simple pricing target so we can model.
- Co-sell commitment: we’ll treat this as a pilot-to-deal path. Ben — recommend a success metric (e.g., 3 pilot customers, or $X MQLs) to trigger co-sell privileges.

Propose a 30‑minute kickoff: Tues Jun 11 10am PT or Wed Jun 12 1pm PT. Which works?

I’ve attached a pilot checklist template for the intake; Sam, if you can also share a short SOW draft we’ll review and return a versioned SOW.

Thanks — Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Director, Alliances | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0161

---

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai, Sam Patel <sam@orchid-analytics.com>
Date: Fri, 07 Jun 2029 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: 8-week SellWith Accelerator pilot (Orchid + Redwood)

Quick notes / what I need from Orchid to scope commercial + marketplace commitments: 

- Pilot SOW with deliverables and acceptance criteria (please include success metrics).
- Expected token/dev consumption (daily QPS estimate or monthly token budget).
- Target pilot pricing and any desired private-offer pricing band.
- Confirmation who will own customer acquisition post-pilot (Orchid or joint).

Internal ask list from Partnerships/GTM: 
- We can offer a co-marketing credit and webinar support if the pilot hits the agreed metric.
- For AWS Private Offer / SellWith, we need evidence: SOC2 report, data flow diagram, legal contact, and expected SKU mapping.
- If Orchid wants a co-sell label in Marketplace, we’ll require a commercial review (legal + finance) which takes ~2-3 weeks after SOW.

I’ll prepare a draft pilot-sow_v1 and attach — feel free to iterate. Also planning a short pricing model to share on kickoff.

—Ben
Ben Carter | Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachment: pilot-sow_v1.pdf (draft)

---

From: Sam Patel <sam@orchid-analytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: Sara Lopez <sara@brightlayer.consulting>, aws-partner@amazon.com
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2029 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: 8-week SellWith Accelerator pilot (Orchid + Redwood)

Thanks — attached is a quick SOW draft and a technical-runbook (end-to-end) that BrightLayer will execute. We’ve left acceptance criteria intentionally specific: two retail pilots with baseline-run metrics and a joint webinar target.

Files attached: pilot-sow_v1.pdf, integration-runbook.xlsx

A few clarifying points from our side: 
- Timeline: we’re targeting a kickoff week of Jun 17 and completion by Aug 9 (8 weeks).
- Private Offer: our procurement team wants to list an entry-level private offer to accelerate trials for our marquee customers; can Redwood map one SKU that routes to the dedicated pool?
- Marketplace listing: what’s the fastest path to be discoverable for co-sell? Is an initial private offer + co-marketing enough to surface on the Buy/Integrate flow?

Would love to lock kickoff Tue Jun 18 10am PT if you can accommodate (we realize change from earlier suggested dates).

Best,
Sam

---

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam@orchid-analytics.com>, jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2029 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: 8-week SellWith Accelerator pilot (Orchid + Redwood)

On Mon, Jun 10, 2029 at 08:30 AM Sam Patel <sam@orchid-analytics.com> wrote:
> Thanks — attached is a quick SOW draft and a technical-runbook (end-to-end) that BrightLayer will execute.
> 
> Files attached: pilot-sow_v1.pdf, integration-runbook.xlsx

Thanks for the SOW — quick technical confirmation from our side:

- We can provision a dedicated small GPU pool and pin a private-offer SKU to that pool for the pilot.
- Metering: we’ll provide a SKU-to-meter mapping template; Orchid’s expected QPS will determine the SKU granularity.
- Private Offer routing: feasible, but finance/legal sign-off required; plan 2–3 business days for initial mapping, 10–15 business days for full private-offer activation in some cloud marketplaces.
- Security evidence: we need SOC2 report (or attestation), data-flow diagram, and an IAM contact for provisioning; BrightLayer can run the SSO work in week 1.

Action items / next steps: 
1) Sam / BrightLayer: confirm kickoff Tue Jun 18 10am PT (OK?) and upload SOW to the shared drive (link please).
2) Orchid: send expected token/QPS numbers and target pricing band.
3) Ben: start commercial review once SOW is in Drive (you mentioned HS-78421).
4) Connor/Infra: will provision the pool after SOW approval (ETA depends on finance sign-off).

I’ll add a short integration checklist to the Drive and update with notes after kickoff.

—Connor O'Brien
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai
